historical_reviews.deepseek: The passive direction is reasonable, but the range label does not enumerate modules and no transceiver port/serial or DOM provenance is established. The capped fallback and missing Web evidence are incomplete.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly includes link context and forbids link-control writes. This review adds pluggable-module presence, PN/serial and DOM-versus-board-proxy semantics.

original_test_intent: Validate the transceiver temperature associated with each applicable LP1–LP8 path, proving the correct port/module identity, telemetry source, readable value and enabled thresholds in raw BMC evidence and both Web views.
original_method: The network/platform owner maps LP1–LP8 to physical ports and installed transceiver serials, defines whether BMC reports module DOM or a board-side proxy sensor, supplies module-specific limits and Web mappings, then automation collects passive per-member evidence with link context.
manual_activity: The network/platform owner maps each applicable LP index to a physical cage/port and installed transceiver PN/serial, defines DOM or proxy-sensor meaning and thresholds, and confirms both BMC-Web entries. No module insertion/removal or link change is authorized.
required_inputs: Authoritative LP1–LP8 to cage/port/lane/link topology and applicability
Installed transceiver vendor/PN/serial/revision/form factor per member
Telemetry source as module DOM/DDM or a board-side thermal proxy and its physical location
Exact SDR name/record/entity and Dashboard/Server Health mapping
Units, scaling, accuracy/tolerance, polling/freshness and absent-module semantics
Module-specific normal range and enabled thresholds under documented optical/link/load/ambient state
BMC/SDR/NIC/switch/transceiver firmware and thermal/link specification revisions
Secret-safe collection, full evidence retention and independent link/BMC recovery owner
safety_requirements: Do not infer LP or port mapping from index alone; bind each sensor to an installed module serial
Enumerate exact LP1–LP8 records; the tilde label is not one valid sensor query
Keep TRX telemetry distinct from LP chip/board temperature
Distinguish missing module, DOM unsupported, stale proxy and true thermal fault
Retain full SDR and enabled thresholds; no 100-line truncation
Do not flap links, disable ports/lasers, service modules, change firmware/thresholds, reset BMC or clear logs
Stop on link degradation, LOS/fault, missing/stale/invalid temperature, unsafe rise or BMC instability; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify source identity, LP-port topology and installed transceiver identity
Capture complete read-only SDR/Sensor inventory and exact per-member TRX results
Parse value, state, freshness, enabled thresholds and DOM/proxy provenance
Build port/module parity and prepare both Web entries
Correlate passive link state, LOS/fault, optical health, SEL and BMC evidence
Perform no link/module/laser/threshold control or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve LP-to-port/module mapping and telemetry source
Provide module-specific temperature ranges and thresholds
Confirm both Web mappings and absent/unsupported handling
Review every transceiver result with link context and issue the overall decision

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Read-only exact queries are useful only after the eight names are resolved; `'TEMP_LP1~8_TRX'` does not enumerate them, the fallback is incomplete, credentials are exposed and module/link/Web identity is absent.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Through secret-safe OOB access, retain the full SDR inventory and query each mapped TRX record separately, preserving threshold flags, module serial and link state, then compare the same channel in Dashboard and Server Health.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: LP1~8_TRX scope, two Web paths, reading/threshold criterion and 1/1-minute estimates remain; topology, module identity and thresholds are not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES LP PORT/TRANSCEIVER TELEMETRY AND THRESHOLD PACKAGE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a port-to-module-serial sensor matrix, collect passive DOM/proxy values with link state and reconcile enabled thresholds across raw and both Web views.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds physical optical-module and telemetry-source provenance and converts the literal range to exact member collection.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: LP chip temperature cannot replace module temperature; one literal result or generic SDR excerpt cannot prove eight installed transceivers or their thresholds.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Readback is passive, but false module attribution or stale DOM may conceal an optic hotspot and impending link failure.

project_override_considerations: Empty cages, copper cables and modules without DOM need explicit not-applicable/unsupported rules. Breakout links or shared proxy sensors require a versioned mapping that states whether one value legitimately covers multiple lanes or ports.
expected_evidence: LP1–LP8 physical port/lane topology and installed module PN/serial inventory
Per-member DOM/proxy source, exact SDR/entity and both Web mappings
Value, units, state, freshness and enabled-threshold table with module-specific limits
Complete redacted SDR plus exact member outputs with status/timestamps
Dashboard and Server Health evidence per module
Passive link/LOS/fault/optical/SEL/BMC context and missing/unsupported/stale analysis

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The row consistently targets LP1–LP8 transceiver temperatures and Web thresholds. Missing topology, module identities and values are incomplete project data, not contradictory targets.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A passive transceiver-temperature validation path is identifiable. LP/port mapping, module inventory, telemetry source and thresholds are supplyable readiness inputs under ED-36.

review_improvement: Adds port/module-serial and DOM/proxy provenance, protects live links and prevents LP chip sensors, literal ranges or truncated output from substituting for transceiver evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: A transceiver thermal result is meaningful only when tied to a physical cage and module serial; module replacement or breakout topology can change the mapping without changing an LP label. BMC telemetry may mirror DOM or represent a nearby proxy, which affects both accuracy and limits. Passive link and LOS context helps detect stale or absent modules without exercising the link.
